product_overview: A web-based real estate CRM to manage properties, clients, proposals and marketing including WhatsApp integration, with an admin panel for agents and a public site for property listings.
core_goals: Provide role-based access to manage properties, clients and proposals securely.
Enable agents to track leads and client interactions with CRM workflows.
Support property lifecycle with image gallery, status and advanced filters.
Integrate WhatsApp and campaign tools for messaging and lead outreach.
Expose a public site for browsing, searching and contacting about properties.
Offer administrative controls for users, roles and system configuration.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User login, registration and role-based access control for Admin and Agent accounts.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Click Login button -> See dashboard
Navigate to /register -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Click Register button -> See verification/confirmation or redirected to /login
Navigate to /login -> Fill email field with wrong password -> Click Login button -> See error message 'Invalid credentials'
Navigate to /admin/users -> Click Create User -> Fill user details -> Select role 'Agent' -> Click Save -> See new user in list
Navigate to /admin/users -> Open user without admin permissions -> Click Edit -> Attempt to change role -> See 'Permission denied' error

features.name: Property Management
features.description: Create, read, update and delete properties with multi-image gallery, status management and admin filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /properties -> Click Add Property -> Fill title field -> Select type and purpose -> Fill price field -> Fill address fields -> Upload images -> Click Save -> See property in list
Navigate to /properties -> Use search/filter by city and status -> See filtered results
Navigate to /properties/{id} -> Click Edit -> Change status to 'Sold' -> Click Save -> See updated status on property page
Navigate to /properties -> Click Add Property -> Fill required fields incompletely -> Click Save -> See validation errors indicating missing fields
Navigate to /properties/{id} -> Click Delete -> Confirm deletion -> See property removed from list
Navigate to /properties -> Click Add Property -> Upload invalid file format for image -> Click Save -> See image upload error 'Unsupported file type'

features.name: Client Management
features.description: Register and manage clients/leads with tags, status, interaction history and CSV import with duplicate detection.
user_flows: Navigate to /clients -> Click New Client -> Fill name, phone and email -> Select type and origin -> Click Save -> See client in list
Navigate to /clients/{id} -> Add observation/note -> Click Save Note -> See note in client history
Navigate to /clients -> Click Import -> Upload CSV file -> Map fields -> Click Import -> See import summary with created leads and detected duplicates
Navigate to /clients -> Click New Client -> Submit with missing required fields -> See validation errors
Navigate to /clients -> Click Import -> Upload malformed CSV -> Click Import -> See import error message and no import performed

features.name: Proposals
features.description: Create and manage proposals linking clients to properties with value, commission and status workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to /proposals -> Click New Proposal -> Select client -> Select property -> Fill proposal value and commission -> Click Save -> See proposal in list with status 'Sent'
Navigate to /proposals/{id} -> Change status to 'Approved' -> Click Save -> See updated status and notification to agent
Navigate to /proposals -> Click New Proposal -> Select property that is already 'Sold' -> Click Save -> See error 'Property not available for proposals'
Navigate to /proposals -> Open proposal with missing client -> Click Edit -> Attempt to save without client -> See validation error 'Client required'

features.name: Marketing & WhatsApp
features.description: Manage campaigns and WhatsApp messaging (chat, broadcast) with send schedules and messaging logs.
user_flows: Navigate to /campaigns -> Click New Campaign -> Select target tags -> Compose message -> Set send schedule -> Click Send -> See campaign queued and scheduled messages list
Navigate to /whatsapp/settings -> Fill API key and webhook URL -> Click Save -> See 'WhatsApp configured' success message
Navigate to /chat -> Open conversation with client -> Type message -> Click Send -> See message appear in conversation and in message_logs
Navigate to /campaigns -> Click New Campaign -> Select recipients with invalid phone format -> Click Send -> See validation errors for invalid numbers and prevented broadcast
While sending broadcast -> WhatsApp API returns error -> See campaign status 'Failed' and error details in logs

features.name: Public Site
features.description: Public-facing website with home, property catalogue, detailed property pages and contact form for lead capture.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See home with recent properties highlighted
Navigate to /site/properties -> Use filters by city and type -> See filtered property list
Navigate to /site/properties/{id} -> See property details page with gallery, description and contact form
On /site/properties/{id} -> Fill contact form with name and phone -> Click Send -> See 'Message sent' confirmation and lead created in CRM
Navigate to /site/properties -> Use full text search with no matches -> See 'No properties found' message

features.name: Administration & Configuration
features.description: Admin tools to manage users, roles/permissions, system settings and API keys.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/roles -> Click New Role -> Define permissions -> Click Save -> See role in list
Navigate to /admin/users -> Click Edit on a user -> Change roles/permissions -> Click Save -> See updated permissions take effect
Navigate to /settings -> Update system API keys and business hours -> Click Save -> See confirmation 'Settings updated'
Navigate to /admin/roles -> Attempt to access as non-admin -> See 'Permission denied' and no access to role management
Navigate to /settings -> Enter invalid API key format -> Click Save -> See validation error and settings not saved
